claim_scope: Finite-time exact reconstruction of positive distinct OU-noise relaxation rates, their amplitudes, and unknown thermal diffusion coefficient from 2N+1 equally spaced net-current variances of a homogeneous, noninteracting independent-particle Poisson gas; plus nonparametric identification boundaries.
integrity_note: Proof uses explicit Poisson thinning, stationary Gaussian variance integration, established Hankel/Prony moment reconstruction, and invariance of domain; numerical checks are supplemental and do not establish infinite-dimensional claims. Earlier work is acknowledged. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Ideal noise-free ensemble variance measurements; known homogeneous gas density, fixed number of positive distinct OU components, independent stationary Gaussian forcing and particles; sharp lower bound concerns predetermined scalar times. No stable inversion at nearly merged rates; arbitrary Gaussian spectral families require all-time data and regularization. Does not cover interacting particles.
title: Sharp current-variance tomography of multiscale Gaussian active gases
